name: core
deliverable: Labels every project gets, whatever its type: roles, triage and the core issue types.

labels.name: hub
labels.description: The pinned entry point of the project record

labels.name: final-record
labels.description: Topic issue: the body is current deliverable text, the comments are its history

labels.name: active
labels.description: Work in development; names its destination topic; carries no section labels

labels.name: triage
labels.description: Opened by hand; not yet placed in the record (see the triage workflow)

labels.name: needs-decision
labels.description: Waiting for a decision from the owner

labels.name: migrated
labels.description: Content copied from an older tracker

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something does not work as it should

labels.name: type:question
labels.description: A question to answer from the record or the owner

labels.name: type:data
labels.description: A problem or request about data

labels.name: type:decision-needed
labels.description: Only the owner can settle it
